name: playwright
description: Pointer-only preset for the Playwright end-to-end testing framework. Surfaces the canonical Playwright skill suite (`microsoft/playwright-cli`, Apache-2.0) at install time — authoritative API patterns updated alongside each Playwright release. No foundation skill filter, no marketplace plugin, no defaults override. Vendor-neutrality accepted **case-by-case** per the foundation policy: Microsoft owns Playwright (created 2020), the project predates the deepening OpenAI commercial relationship, and Playwright remains the de-facto standard for E2E testing. Re-evaluate if Microsoft's commercial alignment with OpenAI changes the Playwright roadmap visibly. See `docs/recipes/recommended-vendor-skills.md` §Microsoft Playwright and `specs/presets-vendor-pointer-tier/spec.md` for the tier semantics.

recommendedVendorSkills.rationale: Authoritative Playwright API patterns from the Microsoft Playwright team, updated alongside each Playwright release. Verified via `gh api repos/microsoft/playwright-cli` on 2026-05-18 — 10,457★, last commit 2026-05-07, Apache-2.0, not archived. Pair with claude-base's qa-e2e skill (workflow patterns + anti-fragility rules).

outOfScope: Foundation skill curation — no `foundation.skills.keep/drop` filter (vendor-pointer tier)
Opinionated install-time defaults — inherited from foundation defaults
Non-Playwright E2E frameworks (Cypress, WebdriverIO, TestCafe) — out of this preset's scope; see claude-base's `qa-e2e` skill for stack-neutral patterns
Unit / integration testing (Vitest, Jest, etc.) — distinct from E2E
